description: This PHP source file defines the CacheService class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing cache instances, specifically using FilesystemAdapter. It provides a static method to retrieve or instantiate cache objects based on a namespace.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Provides static access to cache instances, utilizing a namespace to manage different cache domains.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache adapter instance for the specified namespace, creating a new FilesystemAdapter if one doesn't already exist.
